verdict.rationale: Bolna is a voice-agent platform, so consuming external MCP servers as agent tools is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack does not show Bolna doing this. The documented MCP material covers only Bolna's own MCP server, which lets external clients such as Claude or Cursor control a Bolna account; that is server-side and not this story. The tools tab and integrations docs mention built-in tools but never MCP server connections.
